traditional: the Moon sextile Mercury: a soft contact. The body, home, and daily needs supports communication, commerce, and contracts - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Emotion meets mind. How feeling and thinking inform each other, and how readily the inner life gets put into words. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Thought and communication flow; expression is instinctive and fluent. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize feeling and thinking into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what feeling and thinking have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and scattered overthinking go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: It is easier to say what you actually feel when you stop spending half the conversation defending your right to feel it.
readerCopy.body: It is easier to say what you actually feel when you stop spending half the conversation defending your right to feel it. When the Moon sextiles Mercury, emotion and language fall into alignment, letting you lay out what bothered you, what shifted, or what you require without turning a baseline truth into an argument you have to win. You don't need absolute consensus to state your reality. Name what happened clearly enough to give the exchange somewhere real to go.
